name: MCP Bridge for JMeter
description: A localhost-only MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing generic JMeter test-plan operations — reading and editing whatever's currently open in the GUI — to any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code, Codex, opencode). Ten tools: get_tree, get_element_properties, add_element, modify_element, clone_element, move_element, delete_element, get_arguments, modify_argument and a heuristic analyze_dynamic_candidates scan. Every write goes through JMeter's own undo transaction. Split out from Correlation Studio so it's usable independently of that or any other plugin.
